easy_fields.name: CONTEXTUAL
easy_fields.creator: Rohan Wadhawan, Hritik Bansal, Kai-Wei Chang, Nanyun Peng
easy_fields.publisher: Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235
easy_fields.citeAs: Wadhawan, R., Bansal, H., Chang, K.-W., & Peng, N. (2024). CONTEXTUAL: Evaluating Context-Sensitive Text-Rich Visual Reasoning in Large Multimodal Models. Proceedings of the 41st International Conference on Machine Learning, PMLR 235.
easy_fields.description: CONTEXTUAL is a novel dataset featuring 506 human-crafted instructions that require context-sensitive reasoning for text-rich images. It aims to benchmark the state-of-the-art multimodal models' capability on context-sensitive text-rich visual reasoning across eight real-world scenarios.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper details the guidelines for data collection, the sources of images (LAION-5B, Rico Dataset, Open WebText Initiative, existing VQA datasets), and the process of creating instruction-response pairs.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper provides a detailed, multi-stage annotation protocol, mentions the platform (Amazon Mechanical Turk), discusses quality control (verification, author review), and gives some demographic information about annotators.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper explicitly discusses potential biases related to annotator demographics, limitations of models on the dataset, social impact considerations, and states that no privacy-sensitive information was observed.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper describes image filtering as a preprocessing step and outlines the data release strategy and ongoing leaderboard maintenance, though imputation and manipulation protocols for the dataset itself are not detailed.
